messages:
ellie_cust: Hey team — noticed a subtle behavior change after the model rollout last night (model v8.2). Replies are consistently shorter and skip clarifying Qs/examples that used to be present. Not a crash, but it breaks a few UX flows. Posting a quick before/after below.

ellie_cust: BEFORE (v8.1):
```json
{
  "prompt": "How do I add a new user to the dashboard?",
  "response": "You can add a user by visiting Settings > Users, clicking \"Invite user\", filling email + role. Do you want an example invite message or role mapping?"
}
```

ellie_cust: AFTER (v8.2):
```json
{
  "prompt": "How do I add a new user to the dashboard?",
  "response": "Go to Settings > Users and click \"Invite user\"."
}
```

ellie_cust: We rely on those follow-ups and examples for our onboarding flow — losing them causes more support tickets. Repro is trivial via hosted API.

maria_support: Thanks for the report, @ellie_cust. Could you paste the exact API request you used (headers+body minus any creds) and a request_id from a failing response if available? Also which deployment (hosted vs Dedicated) and region?

ellie_cust: Hosted (us-east). Here's a sanitized curl that reproduces it for us:

```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\n    "model": "redwood-v8.2",\n    "input": "How do I add a new user to the dashboard?",\n    "max_new_tokens": 120,\n    "temperature": 0.0,\n    "top_p": 0.95,\n    "stop": ["\n\n"]\n  }'
```

ellie_cust: Response body (trimmed) includes a trace id in headers: X-Request-ID: x-req-42-abc

jordan_ml: Thanks, ellie. From the payload it looks like deterministic sampling (temp=0) — that can make outputs shorter if the model's length bias changed. Two quick asks:
  1) can you repro with `temperature: 0.7` or raising `top_p` to 0.98 and see if verbosity returns?
  2) can you share a short example where the model used to ask a clarifying question but now doesn't — the two JSON blocks above are perfect.

sam_engineer: I pulled logs for X-Request-ID x-req-42-abc. The request reached hosted-us-east at 2026-02-14T18:22:09Z and routed to pool redwood-us-east-gpu-a. Latency ~210ms for initial token, token throughput normal. No 500s or auth failures.

sam_engineer: Also confirmed `max_new_tokens` in your request was honored (120). So it's not truncation due to a bug.

jordan_ml: Good to know. One hypothesis: the rollout changed default system instruction variants or a subtle length-penalty tweak in the model compilation profile. On some models we tuned a length_bias kernel for shorter outputs to hit latency SLOs.

jordan_ml: Can you try this quick mitigation and report back?
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v8.2",
  "input": "How do I add a new user to the dashboard?",
  "max_new_tokens": 200,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 0.98,
  "instructions": "Prefer to include clarifying questions and a short example when applicable."
}
```

maria_support: @ellie_cust once you run that, paste the response. If verbosity returns we can provide a short mitigation doc for customers while the ML team verifies model-side changes.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: Deployment completed: redwood-v8.2 -> hosted-us-east (rollout id: r-20260214-17). Canary 100% at 2026-02-14T16:45:03Z.

jordan_ml: I'll check the rollout notes and the model variant comparison. If we did adjust length_bias or default system instructions for v8.2, we can either revert that micro-tweak or push a config toggle to honor `instructions`/`style` hints from the request.

sam_engineer: Filed internal ticket INF-4592 to track: "v8.2 length/verbosity regression — investigate length_bias and system instruction diffs." Linking the customer's trace id and the deploy id.

ellie_cust: Thanks — running the temp/top_p change now and will post results shortly. Appreciate the quick response. :pray:
